title: The Sentence Learns to End
label: ch:ur-script-copula
canDo: I can write gol he in the positions a word needs, write bari ye and nun ghunna, read hai, main, hain, nahin, maan and kahan off the page, and write mera naam ... hai from dictation.

payoff.summary: Three letters land on top of the seven, and the copula hai comes off the page -- with it every sentence the reader already knew how to end, including mera naam ... hai, the first sentence the book ever gave them.
